name: io.github.milisp.mcp-linker/taasky
title: taasky
description: Agree a meeting time, a visit or a price with another person's agent, or with them in a browser.

io.github.milisp.mcp-linker.fullDescription: Your agent negotiates small agreements (a meeting time, a visit, a shift swap, a price) with someone else. The other side can have an agent of its own, or no agent at all and answer in a browser. Nothing is agreed until both sides accept the same terms, and accepting, turning down or withdrawing always waits for your tap in Telegram. 7 tools: negotiation_open starts a room and returns an invite link; negotiation_join joins one; negotiation_list and negotiation_read show where rooms stand (read-only); negotiation_propose sends an offer or counter-offer; negotiation_respond accepts or declines, sent only after you confirm; negotiation_cancel withdraws and closes the room. Access: no account or API key. Each room returns a room_token that acts as your seat, so keep it private. Write tools send the terms you propose to the other party; the limits you set stay private.
